第5章 以后你就是我的娘亲（第1页）
林家传自上古，出过准帝，威势在中天道域除了君家外，也是说一不二的主。
“咦，你们看，那不是那个废物二少吗”
“唉，我还以为他跑出去的这几天去寻死了呢，毕竟堂堂林家二少爷，要嫁到君家，没想到他今日又回来了”
“喂，你还别说，或许人家觉得很光荣呢，毕竟那是中天道域唯一的，荒古世家君家，哪怕是个下人，也是高人一等啊”
“人家是做乘龙快婿，不是下人的，你们别乱说，”
“你们都住口，谁让你们这样说琅天二哥的，你们太无礼了”
“嘿嘿，雪儿堂妹，不是我们在说，这是事实嘛”
“你……你们……太气人了”，林雪儿气极欲哭。
就在这时，一只手搭在林雪儿的头上，摸了摸。
“福伯，旁族子弟对宗族语言大不敬，该如何罚”
“每人杖打三十，扣除三个月的修炼资源”福伯眼皮微抬，有此浑浊的瞳孔也是光芒一闪。
“你一个废人，有什么资格行使宗族权利”
“林废物，你敢叫人打我，我一定告诉浩宇哥，让他给我讨回公道”
“福伯，下手用点力，他们还能叫唤，说明不痛”
福伯听到二少爷不像说笑，也是稍稍用力。
林琅天头也不回的离开，林雪儿看着他二哥离开的背影，心中闪过一个念头
“琅天二哥怎么看着，像变了一个人一样”
一位美妇静静坐在花园中，眉头紧皱，似忧似虑。
就在这时，贴身侍女，小红发现了林琅天的身影。
“夫人，夫人你快看，二少爷回来了，他过来看您了”
听到声音，美妇连忙起身，朝门外走去。
隔着还老远，见着了林琅天，喜极而泣的喊道：
“小天，你终于回来了，为娘可担心死你了，你去哪里了，出去也没跟娘亲说一声，可担心死娘亲了”
林琅天看着真情流露的美妇，感受到了关心和爱护，情不自禁的说了一声：
“娘亲，我回来了，我没事，你别担心”
林琅天静静陪着娘亲坐了一会，等到娘亲情绪恢复平静，正准备告辞离开。
“小天，你会不会恨为娘，是娘亲没用，才让你…”
“娘亲也知道你过得一点也不快乐，但为娘也没办法，去求过娘家人，可娘家人也无能为力”
“这事关荒古世家叶家，你大娘她处处针对我们，更视你为眼中针，肉中刺”
“叶沐韵这样千方百计的，整我们母子，就是想以后让她儿子可以顺利，继承林家家主之位吧”
“怕我的出现，影响她儿子的仕途，在她眼里，哪怕我是个废人，也不放过”
“呵，终有一日，这笔账，我会找她们一一清算”
林琅天语气冰冷的看向林家家主方向。
“小天，你…你怎么这样说话?你别吓为娘”美妇边说边摸向林琅天的头。
林琅天伸手抓住娘亲的手缓缓说道：
“娘亲，以前的我太不懂事了，让你操了很多心，每天让你担惊受怕，是孩儿不好。
以后不会了，孩儿已经懂事，等以后有能力了，把娘亲也一起接走，不用在林家再受人针对，我也会把以往所受的痛苦一一偿还”
“小天，你懂事就好，娘亲没事，在林家也不会有什么，你离开给林家，大夫人应该也不回，再处处看我们不舒服”
“娘亲只是担心你，你去了君家不像在林家，为娘再也帮不到你了，你要好好的对待君家的丫头”
“就算你是上门女婿，只要你能对君家丫头好，不看僧面也会看佛面，君家人也不会对你怎么样的”
“只要小天你好好的活着，为娘就不再奢求什么了”
“看着这个原本只是血缘上的娘亲，这一刻，看到的声声关爱，句句嘱咐，字字担忧，这一刻，动容了，以后，你就是我娘亲，真正的娘亲”！

Chapter 5 You will be my mother from now on (Page 1)
The Lin family has its origins in ancient times and has produced quasi-emperors. In addition to the Jun family, they are also the most powerful masters in the Zhongtian Dao domain.
"Hey, look, isn't that the good-for-nothing Second Young Master?"
"Oh, I thought he was seeking death after running away these past few days. After all, the second young master of the Lin family is going to marry into the Jun family. I didn't expect him to come back today."
"Hey, don't tell me, maybe people think it's very honorable. After all, it's the only one in the Zhongtian Dao Domain. Even if you are a subordinate of the ancient family, you are still superior to others."
"I am a son-in-law who can ride a dragon, not a servant. Don't talk nonsense."
"Shut up, you all. Who told you to talk about Brother Langtian like this? You are so rude."
"Hey, cousin Xue'er, it's not us who are saying this, this is the truth."
"You...you...are so irritating." Lin Xueer was so angry that she wanted to cry.
At this moment, a hand was placed on Lin Xueer's head and touched it.
"Uncle Fu, the children from other clans are disrespectful to the clan language. How should I be punished?"
"Thirty beatings with the cane for each person will deduct three months of cultivation resources." Uncle Fu raised his eyelids slightly, and his turbid pupils also flashed with light.
"You are a useless person, what qualifications do you have to exercise clan rights?"
"Lin Waste, if you dare to ask someone to beat me, I will definitely tell Brother Haoyu and ask him to seek justice for me."
"Uncle Fu, if you use a little force, they can still scream, which means it doesn't hurt."
When Uncle Fu heard that the second young master was not joking, he also exerted a little force.
Lin Langtian left without looking back. Lin Xueer looked at the back of his second brother leaving, and a thought flashed in her mind.
"Why does second brother Langtian look like he has changed?"
A beautiful woman sat quietly in the garden, her brows furrowed, as if worried.
At this moment, the personal maid, Xiao Hong, discovered Lin Langtian's figure.
"Madam, madam, look quickly, the second young master is back. He is here to see you."
Hearing the sound, the beautiful woman quickly stood up and walked towards the door.
Still far away, I saw Lin Langtian and cried with joy:
"Xiaotian, you are finally back. My mother is worried about you to death. Where have you been? I didn't even tell my mother when I went out, but I am worried about you to death."
Lin Langtian looked at the beautiful woman who showed her true feelings, felt the care and love, and couldn't help but say:
"Mom, I'm back, I'm fine, don't worry"
Lin Langtian sat quietly with his mother for a while, and when her mother regained her composure, she was about to say goodbye and leave.
"Xiaotian, do you hate being your mother? It's because my mother is useless that I let you..."
"My mother also knows that your life is not happy at all, but there is nothing you can do about it. I have tried to beg your mother's family, but there is nothing they can do."
"This is about the Ye family, an ancient family. Your aunt targets us everywhere, and she sees you as a thorn in our side and a thorn in our flesh."
"Ye Muyun tried every possible means to punish our mother and son just because she wanted her son to succeed in succeeding as the head of the Lin family."
"She is afraid that my appearance will affect her son's career. In her eyes, she will not let me go even if I am a useless person."
"Oh, one day, I will ask them to settle this account one by one."
Lin Langtian looked in the direction of the head of the Lin family with a cold tone.
"Xiaotian, you...why are you talking like this? Don't be scared," the beautiful woman said while touching Lin Langtian's head.
Lin Langtian reached out and grabbed his mother's hand and said slowly:
"Mom, I was too ignorant in the past. I made you worry a lot and made you worried every day. It was your child's fault.
It won’t happen in the future. The child is already sensible. When he is able in the future, he will take his mother away with him so that he won’t have to be targeted again in the Lin family. I will also repay the pain I suffered in the past."
"Xiaotian, just be sensible. Mom will be fine, and nothing will happen to you in the Lin family. If you leave for the Lin family, the eldest lady will probably not come back. It will make us uncomfortable if you look at us everywhere."
"Mom is just worried about you. When you go to Jun's house, it's not like you were at Lin's house. Mom can't help you anymore. You have to treat the girls of Jun's house well."
"Even if you are the son-in-law, as long as you treat the Jun family girl well and look at the Buddha's face even if you don't look at the monk's face, the Jun family will not do anything to you."
"As long as you live well, Xiaotian, I won't ask for anything more from my mother."
"Looking at this mother who was originally just a blood relative, at this moment, I saw the sounds of care, instructions, and worries. At this moment, I was moved. From now on, you will be my mother, the real mother!"
